title: One Live Contract per Facility under Commercial and Industrial Electricity Contracts
content:
**Commercial and Industrial Electricity Contracts - facilities and contracts held by one business.**

1. A business may hold any number of C&I contracts, one per facility. No limit applies to the number of facilities one business places under Beacon Ridge C&I contracts.
2. No other C&I contract on the same facility may be in pending enrollment, active, termination pending or holdover status when a new contract is executed.
3. A facility still on a live Beacon Ridge small business electricity agreement may sign a C&I contract; the small business agreement must then be cancelled with the C&I upgrade drop reason, which is how holding the C&I contract changes the small business termination fee.

## Basis of the facility check

- The check reads Beacon Ridge's own contract records for the facility as they stand before the new contract is executed. A customer's account of an earlier contract does not take the place of the record.
- "Same facility" means the same premise. C&I contracts at the business's other premises play no part in the check.

## Status of another C&I contract on the same facility

| Status of the other contract | Executing a new contract for that facility |
|---|---|
| pending enrollment | not permitted |
| active | not permitted |
| termination pending | not permitted |
| holdover | not permitted |
| closed | not barred by this rule |
| rejected | not barred by this rule |

## Illustrations (hypothetical)

- A business with active C&I contracts at two plants signs a quote for a third plant that has no C&I contract: clause 2 does not bar it, and the business then holds three contracts, one per facility.
- A facility whose earlier C&I contract is still in holdover cannot have a new C&I contract executed while that contract remains in holdover.
- A facility supplied under a live small business electricity agreement signs a C&I contract: the C&I contract may be signed, and the small business agreement is then cancelled with the C&I upgrade drop reason.
